data.title: Solana Address Realizes $1.57 Million Profit on ZCAT Holdings
data.description: A Solana address identified as GZetT…1J2vq opened a ZCAT position six days ago at $0.00005785 and became the token's fourth-largest holder. According to Odaily, the address has sold 36.6% of its holdings, booked about $1.57 million in profit, and still has about $1.51 million in unrealized gains, with an estimated return of 100,870%.

data.title: Binance Futures to Launch PONSUSDT and 哈基米USDT Perpetual Contracts
data.description: According to the announcement from Binance, Binance Futures will launch two USDⓈ-M perpetual contracts to expand trading choices and support users’ trading activity. The PONSUSDT perpetual contract is scheduled to launch on 2026-09-06 06:45 (UTC) with up to 20x leverage, while the 哈基米USDT perpetual contract is scheduled to launch on 2026-09-06 07:15 (UTC) with up to 3x leverage. Both contracts will use USDT as the settlement asset and will trade 24/7. Binance said the contracts will also be available for Futures Copy Trading within 24 hours of launch. The announcement states that PONS (Pons) is a non-custodial token launchpad and native cryptocurrency built on the Robinhood Chain, an Ethereum Layer 2 network, while 哈基米 (Hajimi) is described as a Chinese meme coin. For PONSUSDT, the tick size is 0.0001, the minimum trade amount is 1 PONS, and the minimum notional value is 5 USDT. For 哈基米USDT, the tick size is 0.00001, the minimum trade amount is 1 哈基米, and the minimum notional value is 5 USDT. Both contracts have a capped funding rate of +2.00% / -2.00%, funding fee settlement every four hours, maximum leverage of 3x, and Multi-Assets Mode support. Binance also said contract specifications may be adjusted based on market risk conditions.

data.title: Israel Says It Struck Southern Lebanon in Response to Hezbollah Action
data.description: According to Wallstreetcn, the Israel Defense Forces said it carried out airstrikes in southern Lebanon on the 6th in response to Hezbollah activity, after Hezbollah fighters launched two drones at Israeli soldiers operating in Lebanon's southern "security zone" earlier in the day; the military said it shot down one of the drones and no Israeli personnel were injured.

data.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guards Strike U.S. Naval Drone Near Strait of Hormuz
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said on September 6 that its navy struck a U.S. naval drone that attempted to enter Iran's "protected zone" in the Strait of Hormuz.

data.title: Solana Meme Coin ZCAT Hits Record Market Cap Above $94 Million
data.description:
Solana-based meme coin ZCAT briefly pushed its market capitalization above $94 million, a record high, before easing to $87.9 million. According to Odaily, the token was up more than 240% over the past 24 hours.

ZCAT is built around the Zcash privacy narrative and features an anonymous cat wearing a paper bag. Its model distributes trading revenue to ZCAT holders in ZEC, creating a yield narrative around holding the meme coin. Crypto KOL Ansem reposted and commented on ZCAT-related content several times on X on the same day.

data.title: Pons Says Its Tokens Accounted for 73.5% of Robinhood Chain Launchpad Volume
data.description: Pons said on X that tokens issued through its platform accounted for 73.5% of Robinhood Chain Launchpad's total trading volume over the past 24 hours. According to Odaily, the statement did not provide additional details.

data.title: Raoul Pal Says Ethereum's Value Lies in Assets Secured by the Chain
data.description:
Global Macro Investor founder and CEO Raoul Pal discussed how to value layer 1 blockchains, using Ethereum as an example. According to ChainCatcher, he said that if Ethereum were shut down, stablecoins, DeFi, all layer 2 networks, and NFTs built on it would go to zero.

Pal said layer 1 networks attract assets, capital, and liquidity because of their intellectual density. He added that Ethereum has the largest developer base, strong programmability, and a complete ecosystem. He also rejected discounted cash flow arguments, saying they are meaningless because the valuation target is not cash flow but everything the chain secures.

Pal said that as the world enters the index era, with the human economy and a new agent economy moving on-chain, significant value will accumulate on these base layers.

data.title: Tokenized Stock TVL on Uniswap V4 Reaches $59.1 Million
data.description: Tokenized stock TVL on Uniswap V4 has reached $59.1 million, ranking first among DeFi protocols in the category. According to Odaily, Kamino Lend and Uniswap V3 hold $41.7 million and $20.9 million, respectively. Together, the three protocols account for 63% of total tokenized stock DeFi TVL, which is about $192.6 million.

data.title: U.S. August Nonfarm Payroll Gains Were 98% Female, CNBC Analysis Shows
data.description: According to Jin10, CNBC reported that 98% of the 162,000 jobs added in the U.S. in August were filled by women, according to analysis of Friday's Bureau of Labor Statistics data.

data.title: Israel Defense Forces Orders Lebanese Village Residents Away From Building Before Strike
data.description: According to Sina Finance, the Israel Defense Forces told residents of a village in southern Lebanon to evacuate a building and the surrounding area before a strike. The Israel Defense Forces said the building it planned to strike was a Hezbollah facility, in response to Hezbollah launching an explosive drone at Israeli forces.

data.title: Cathie Wood Says Bitcoin Is Decoupling From Gold as AI Adoption Boosts Jobs
data.description:
Cathie Wood said Bitcoin is gradually decoupling from gold, while companies embracing AI are accelerating job creation. According to Odaily, she said these signals may point to stronger real economic growth and a powerful deflationary cycle driven by technological progress.

Wood also commented on this week’s nonfarm payrolls data, saying the latest jobs report shows the U.S. economy remains strong. She said markets may interpret the figures as a sign of rising inflation and further Federal Reserve tightening, but added that several structural changes are emerging, including 3.7% overall inflation, oil prices potentially falling toward $30, U.S. stocks hitting new highs despite rising rates, and corporate capital spending breaking a bottleneck that has lasted for more than 20 years.

data.title: Robinhood Executive Steven M. Quirk Sells 24,416 Shares on September 3
data.description:
Robinhood Chief Brokerage Officer Steven M. Quirk sold 24,416 shares of the company on September 3 at an average price of $120.33 per share, according to SEC filings. According to ChainCatcher, the sale was valued at about $2.94 million, and Quirk's direct holdings fell to 77,839 shares after the transaction.

Robinhood GC Daniel Martin Jr. also sold 10,000 shares on the same day at an average price of $122.43 per share. According to ChainCatcher, the transaction was valued at about $1.22 million, and Martin's direct holdings declined to 509,943 shares.

data.title: Iran's Revolutionary Guards Release Video of Action Against Violating Vessels, Call U.S. Escort Claims a Lie
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran's Revolutionary Guards said they have publicly released previously undisclosed surveillance footage and video of action taken against violating vessels. The Revolutionary Guards said their naval forces took decisive action and exercised effective control in the Strait of Hormuz, and that any suspicious activity would become a target. They also said the United States is the biggest threat to the security and maritime trade of countries in the region, and that U.S. claims of support and escort are a lie.

data.title: Malaysia PM Economic Adviser Says Fuel Supply Will Be Adequate This Year
data.description: According to Sina Finance, Malaysia's prime minister's economic adviser said the government is confident it will secure adequate fuel supplies by year-end. He told local media on Friday that upside risks to fuel prices remain because of geopolitical tensions and disruptions to key shipping routes. As demand continues to grow, the government may accelerate spending to fund key infrastructure projects such as water supply and power generation.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Ethrex Runs Public Glamsterdam Testnet for Ethereum Privacy EIPs
data.description:
Ethereum execution client ethrex said it is running a public testnet based on Glamsterdam to test EIPs related to Ethereum's privacy roadmap. According to Foresight News, the testnet supports EIP-8141 for frame transactions, EIP-8250 for key randomness, EIP-8272 for recent roots, EIP-7805 for FOCIL, and EIP-8369 for VOPS profiles, with each implementation meeting the latest requirements in its specification.

The implementation of frame transactions is aligned with the latest execution-spec test version. Anyone can sync the network, establish peer connections, make transactions, and use a faucet to fund test accounts.

data.title: Polymarket Washington Nationals Option Jumps to 78.5% Amid Sharp Volatility

According to ChainCatcher, Catcher Predict monitoring flagged the sharp move and noted that related breaking news may be influencing the market.

data.title: AI TRENDS | StonkFun Launches on Raydium LaunchLab on Solana
data.description: StonkFun has launched on Raydium LaunchLab on Solana, with new StonkFun project deployments now routed through LaunchLab. According to Foresight News, the setup is intended to lower deployment costs and reduce sniper risk. After graduation, liquidity will increase through an automatic compounding mechanism.

data.title: Ignas Says Robinhood Fee Model Leaves Little Revenue for Ethereum L1
data.description:
DeFi researcher Ignas said Robinhood previously set a single-day fee record of more than $6 million, with about 10% flowing to Arbitrum and only a very small amount ultimately reaching Ethereum L1.

According to ChainCatcher, Ignas argued that the model may not be entirely unacceptable, comparing it to Uber’s early subsidy-driven growth strategy. He said Ethereum could use L2s to attract traditional finance into its ecosystem and later raise “rent” after switching costs become high.

Ignas added that if Ethereum developers can define a clear strategy to first attract more L2s and then monetize them once switching costs are sufficiently high, it could become a long-term business model that benefits L1. He said no such clear strategy is currently visible in Ethereum’s roadmap and asked whether he may be misunderstanding it.

data.title: BNB Chain Executive Says Lower Gas Fees Are No Longer Blockchain's Top Priority
data.description:
BNB Chain Growth Director Nina Rong said lowering gas fees is no longer the blockchain industry’s top priority. According to Odaily, she said the sector should focus on building sustainable business models, including gas fees, revenue sharing, and other commercial arrangements.

Rong said blockchain foundations have mainly been known for grants, investments, and reducing gas fees over the past five years. She added that a stable business structure is needed for blockchain companies to keep developing over the next five years.

Her comments came after Solana co-founder Anatoly Yakovenko and Arbitrum co-founder Steven Goldfeder debated Robinhood Chain’s fee structure. Yakovenko said Robinhood Chain could use the 10% revenue share paid to Arbitrum to subsidize user transactions and make them gas-free if it joined Solana. Goldfeder replied that if Robinhood chose Solana, it would not earn any revenue from gas fees.

data.title: STOCKS | Morgan Stanley Reiterates Overweight Rating on Microsoft, Keeps $600 Target
data.description: According to Jin10, Morgan Stanley reiterated its overweight rating on Microsoft and kept its $600 target price after the company announced a broad overhaul of its external reporting structure effective in fiscal 2027.
